ds: Monks who study death itself.
The archetypal martial artist monk — every Flurry of Blows hit can knock an opponent down, push them back, or shut off their reactions.
Monks who channel radiant energy.

A paladin sworn to outlast rather than to strike first, refusing to fall even at 0 hit points.
Paladins who pursue heroic deeds and legend.
Paladins who seek peace and redemption before violence.

Paladins sworn to punish those who have committed grievous sins.
Paladins sworn to preserve life, light, and joy in the world.
Paladins sworn to law, society, and sovereign.
Guardians against extraplanar threats.
Paladins who broke their oath and turned to darker ambitions. The DMG presents it as a villain option; DM approval recommended.

Rangers who bond with a beast companion.

Rangers marked by the Feywild — charming, mobile, and unsettling.
Rangers who hunt in darkness and strike first.
Rangers who guard the boundaries between planes.

 This subclass focuses on a unique identity, combat role, and spell progression.
Rogues who manifest psychic blades.
